summary_1line: Agni reveals himself to Krishna and Arjuna, asking their help to burn Khandava forest, prompting a backstory involving King Swetaki’s relentless sacrifices.

image_candidates.scene_text: Agni disguised as a Brahmana stands before Krishna and Arjuna near the Khandava forest, revealing his blazing divine form as he asks them to help him consume the woods.
King Swetaki stands motionless in severe penance on Mount Kailasa with arms raised for months until Shiva appears before him.
